points.description: States that the stack operation corresponding to enqueue is push (adding an element to the stack/top).
points.partial_credit: Award about 2 marks if the answer only describes adding/inserting an element to the stack without naming push, or names push alongside a wrong or contradictory operation.

rubric.notes: Full marks (5) for stating "push" in any wording, even a single word or a short phrase like "push operation". Part marks (about 2) for describing insertion onto the stack without naming push, or for naming push but also giving a conflicting answer. No marks for pop, peek/top, or unrelated operations.
